version_scope.platform: Steam PC, Windows 10 x86-64, App ID 646570
version_scope.content_scope: Unmodded original game; standard Ironclad Ascension 0 slices only; excludes Slay the Spire 2, Daily, Custom, Endless, mods, ports, and board game

sources.notes: Pins the original game's identity and official deckbuilding-roguelike scope, not detailed mechanics.
Pins the named PC release; a future runtime oracle must additionally record build and binary identities.
Cross-check of turn Energy, draw, hand/discard/exhaust zones, reshuffle, and end-turn behavior.
Cross-check of selected card constants, Block/HP order and cap, and combat-scoped Status/Power behavior.
Cross-check of Offering, actual HP-loss signaling, Runic Cube draw, and observable reaction order.
Cross-check of reward choice, rarity-offset state, relic rarity, eligibility, and per-run uniqueness.
Cross-check of enemy planned action, visible Intent projection, and Runic Dome masking.
Cross-check of run teardown, Ironclad unlock group 1, future pool eligibility, and character-scoped Ascension.
Lead for path-dependent RNG consumption only; never the sole source of an oracle.

mechanics.title: Turn Energy and ordered card-zone transitions

quantities.domain: exactly 3 at normal player-turn start before modifiers
exactly 5 at normal player-turn start before modifiers

operations.ordering: Refresh Energy, then draw from the ordered draw pile; if empty, shuffle the discard pile using the named stream and continue drawing.
Validate play and reserve cost before effects; resolve the card's ordered actions, then move its instance to discard or exhaust exactly once.
Resolve end-of-player-turn hooks, move non-retained hand cards in stable hand order, drain Energy, then admit enemy actions.

mechanics.title: Card action outcomes, Block/damage order, and combat-scoped Status/Power lifecycle

quantities.domain: exactly 1 for unupgraded Strike
exactly 6 before modifiers for unupgraded Strike
quantities.rounding: modifier-specific integer policy; not exercised here

quantities.domain: exactly 5 before modifiers for unupgraded Defend
quantities.rounding: modifier-specific integer policy; not exercised here

quantities.domain: exactly 2 for unupgraded Bash
inclusive range 0..999

operations.ordering: Apply declared modifiers, then clamp to the 999 Block boundary and emit the committed delta.
Attack damage consumes Block first; only the unblocked remainder changes HP; defeat follows the committed HP result.
Apply the effect's declared duration/intensity stacking policy; Power instances remain encounter-scoped.
After encounter termination, remove encounter-scoped Power and Status state without mutating the run deck.

mechanics.title: Model-authored Relic reactions to typed intra-action facts

quantities.domain: exactly 6 for unupgraded Offering
exactly 2 for Offering
exactly 3 for unupgraded Offering
exactly 1 after an actual HP-loss fact

operations.ordering: Emit player.hp-lost only after a positive HP delta is established inside the current card-action transaction.
The resolved Runic Cube subscriber draws immediately after HP loss and before the emitting card continues to its own draw action.
Lose 6 HP, deliver same-transaction subscribers, gain 2 Energy, draw 3 cards, then exhaust Offering.

mechanics.title: Run-deck eligibility, distinct reward choices, and explicit skip

quantities.domain: exactly 3 for an unmodified normal-combat reward

operations.ordering: Filter by character, unlock, and policy before ordered distinct draws; do not use deck synergy as an implicit eligibility rule.
Accept exactly one offered card or the explicit skip outcome; soft player strategy is not evaluator-owned build validation.

quantities.domain: exactly 60 before the mutable rarity offset
exactly 37 before the mutable rarity offset
exactly 3 before the mutable rarity offset
exactly -5 at reset
exactly +1 after each common card roll
exactly +40
exactly 50 for ordinary relic rarity selection
exactly 33 for ordinary relic rarity selection
exactly 17 for ordinary relic rarity selection

operations.ordering: For each ordered choice, apply the current rarity policy, select one eligible distinct card, then update offset state before the next choice.
Resolve source and floor restrictions, exclude seen relics, select rarity and item in declared order, then mark the offered relic seen.

mechanics.title: Enemy action plan, visible Intent projection, and execution

quantities.domain: non-negative damage projected for the selected enemy action; fixture value 6

operations.ordering: Select and commit the upcoming action plan before projecting its player-visible Intent.
Project the committed action under the visibility policy; masking changes the observable, not the plan.
After the player turn, execute the exact committed plan; the visible Intent is not executable authority.

mechanics.title: Run teardown, Meta unlock projection, and complete-input replay

quantities.domain: integer groups 0..5; fixture crosses from 0 to 1
character-scoped integer 0..20

operations.ordering: Validate declared Meta transfers, commit them separately, then clear every Run and encounter slot before another run is initialized.
Advance the character-scoped group and add its ordered content identities to Meta availability.
Derive new-run eligible definitions from Meta state while creating fresh Run instances and no retained prior-run deck or relic identity.
Compare two executions only after every reproduction identity and the complete external action trace match.
